build_imagebind_model: build an ImageBindModel instance with custom embed dimensions and transformer block counts for multimodal encoding
create_imagebind_huge: create a pretrained ImageBind huge model by calling imagebind_huge with pretrained set to true
run_forward_multimodal: run the ImageBindModel forward pass with a dict of modality inputs like vision text and audio
review_modality_preprocessors: review the _create_modality_preprocessors method to understand how each modality stem and preprocessor is configured
test_modality_heads: test the _create_modality_heads method to verify each modality head projects embeddings to the output dimension
